questions.question: Job said that wisdom can be bought with gold. True or false?
Job said God knows where wisdom is found. What reason did Job give for this?

answers.text: He sees everything under the heavens
He stored it in the heavens
He hid it in the ocean depths

questions.question: When God set the weight of the wind and measured out the waters, what did He do with wisdom?

answers.text: He looked at it and established it
He divided it among the nations
He poured it out with the rain
